flash_693012.description: The Cantor, the lion, and the fox

flash_693011.description: Degel HaTorah party sources say rabbis have decided to replace veteran MKs Moshe Gafni and Uri Maklev, potentially ending Gafni’s 38-year Knesset career.

flash_693010.description: Yitzhak Meir leads a powerful night of Selichot, music and prayer at the Jerusalem Convention Center as worshippers prepare for the High Holy Days.

flash_693009.description: Hospital throws out dishes after bacon is placed on them in protest over Shabbat closure of new maternity ward food machines.

flash_693013.description: When it came to murdering Jews, the Germans were experts. In saving them, they turned out to be catastrophic incompetents. Opinion.

flash_693022.description: Ash clouds rise up to 15 kilometers as Anak Krakatau continues erupting.

flash_693021.description: The Prime Minister instructed the defense establishment to evacuate outposts established in Area B following heavy pressure from the US administration.

flash_693020.description: Sen. Bernie Sanders calls for an end to the Iran war, saying the conflict is driving up gasoline prices and “wreaking havoc" on the US economy.

flash_693018.description: Former Shin Bet chief Yoram Cohen calls for the evacuation of farms and communities that were not established by government decision. Likud and Religious Zionist leaders slam his remarks.

flash_693016.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee accuses Britain's government of having “lost it" over false Gaza medicine claims.

flash_693014.description: Tens of thousands attend central Selichot prayers at the Western Wall. Smotrich: "We prayed for the success of our soldiers and for victory for the national camp."

flash_693038.description: Thousands of Israeli-Americans call on Ed Sheeran to remove Macklemore from his tour following the rapper's anti-Israel messages during a performance at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey.

flash_693037.description: What is the purpose of the Hebrew Nation?

flash_693035.description: Prominent Muslim Brotherhood cleric says political rise of Zohran Mamdani and Abdul El-Sayed would never have happened without Hamas’ October 7 massacre, calling their success one of the 'blessings' of the attack.

flash_693033.description: Chili Tropper is expected to join the Yashar! party together with candidate Shira Shapira, without Yoaz Hendel. Elisaf Peretz’s status on the party slate remains unclear.

flash_693031.description: The Health Ministry reports that a child has been hospitalized in serious condition in the intensive care unit at Rambam Hospital in Haifa after swimming in the Sea of Galilee and developing severe encephalitis.

flash_693029.description: Holborn and St Pancras is more than a by-election. It is a test of whether those who recognise what is happening in British politics are actually prepared to do something about it. Opinion.

flash_693027.description: They want to leave, Israel wants them to leave, and only those who profess to care about them but just want to use them protest their leaving. So what are we waiting for? Opinion.

flash_693025.description: Loving Israel does not require remaining silent when an Israeli institution gets something wrong. Opinion.

flash_693023.description: Self-esteem and self-image, as well as beliefs about personal capability, are crucial determinants of success

flash_693019.description:
Terrorists from the Hezbollah terrorist organization early Sunday morning launched two drones towards IDF soldiers operating in the Security Zone in southern Lebanon. IDF soldiers opened fire and downed one of the drones. No IDF injuries were reported.

In response, the IDF is now striking in southern Lebanon.

flash_693017.description:
Under the direction of the Chief of the General Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir, a surprise Chief of the General Staff’s exercise, titled “Breaking Dawn 2.0," was launched early Sunday morning to assess the readiness and preparedness of the IDF’s General Headquarters and main headquarters, the order of standby forces, and the ability to respond to a sudden, complex, and large-scale, multi-front scenario.

As part of the surprise exercise, commanders across the regional commands, directorates, and branches were called up. Forces are also being mobilized, and reserves are being assessed. As part of the exercise, increased movement of security forces and aircraft will be felt throughout the country. There is no concern regarding a security incident.

The exercise is being conducted as part of the Operations Directorate’s 2026 exercise program.

flash_693015.description: CENTCOM announces US forces destroyed three Iranian oil tankers after the IRGC launched ballistic missiles at two US Navy ships.

flash_693055.description: Ben-Gvir praised Tzvika Foghel as a “true fighter" after the MK announced he will not run with Otzma Yehudit in the upcoming election.

flash_693054.description: MK Zvika Foghel will not run on Otzma Yehudit's slate in the upcoming elections

flash_693053.description:
Naftali Bennett, chairman of the “Together" party, published his party slate for the Knesset ahead of the elections.

Former Finance and Transportation Ministry director-general Keren Turner will be placed second on the list, former Communications Ministry director-general Liran Avisar Ben-Horin will be third, and former Ra’anana Municipality director-general Michal Hirsch NagrI will be fourth. Knesset member Eitan Ginzburg will be fifth.

They will be followed, in order, by: Yonatan Shalev, Bruria Naim Arman, Amir Strugo, Nisan Zeevi, Orly Harel, Shahar Varon, Esti Ayalon Kovo, Jeremy Saltan, Zvi Plotnitsky, Olesya Kantor, Mati Gil, Tomer Weiner, Tami Muziel, Yael Stern and Amit Barda.

flash_693051.description: The Water Authority and the Ministry of Energy reported that the systems remain stable and that water supplies to residents and the agricultural sector are continuing as normal. At the same time, it was decided to purchase a dedicated stock of membranes for desalination facilities, and the public was asked to use water efficiently and responsibly.

flash_693050.description: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir says Israel’s military must remain ready for a surprise attack as commanders test responses to a rapidly escalating multi-front war.

flash_693048.description: The IDF announced that in a joint operation with the Israel Police and Shin Bet in the Akraba area, a Hamas terrorist cell was thwarted, 10 terrorists were apprehended and a rocket was located.

flash_693046.description: The Medical Corps and Manpower Directorate have developed a new medical fitness classification intended to immediately expand the pool of candidates eligible for combat service.

flash_693045.description: Daniel Pinsky, a 35-year-old sailor from Ariel, is the first Israeli to take part in the Golden Globe race; over 250 days, he will sail alone around the world, with no stops, crew, or GPS, relying only on paper maps and compasses.

flash_693043.description: Members of the Central Elections Committee have once again authorized parties to use apps to track and transmit real-time data on reported voters on Election Day.

flash_693041.description: The Birenstock family releases a moving music video in memory of Maj. Harel Birenstock, featuring his daughter Ori singing in tribute to her father and expressing her deep pain of loss.

flash_693040.description: Israeli President says those who commit violence in Judea and Samaria 'long ago forgot the Torah’s commandment on the treatment of the stranger.'

flash_693036.description: Biblical and traditional names are making a comeback among newborns, for both boys and girls, alongside more modern names such as Naya and Lia.

flash_693034.description: President Herzog condemned escalation of violence in Israel and hinted that, while many systems failed during the Hamas attack on October 7, the police 'saved the country from an even greater disaster.'

flash_693032.description: What was supposed to be a solemn ceremony honoring the victims of 9/11 took an explosive turn when NYC Mayor handed the ceremonial signing pen to his chief counsel, Ramzi Kassem, a controversial lawyer who once represented an Al Qaeda terrorist.

flash_693030.description: Jewish resident Amishav Melet, seen driving security Ranger near US Ambassador Mike Huckabee’s Turmus Ayya visit, says he was responding to a security alert, and claims ambassador was not given the full picture.

flash_693028.description: The terrorist organization withdrew from the Ali al-Taher Ridge and left it to Israeli forces rather than hand the territory over to the Lebanese Army, on orders from the Iranian regime.

flash_693026.description: Heightened alert overseas: The National Security Council warns of growing threats of terrorist attacks against Israelis during the holiday period from terrorist organizations and lone attackers.

flash_693064.description: Lebanese report: Two killed in Israeli strike in Nabatieh area in the south

flash_693063.description: Supreme Court orders state to coordinate return of three Palestinian Arabs to their Samaria homes within 14 days, sharply criticizing enforcement failures.

flash_693061.description:
A man in his 30s was seriously wounded in an incident on Kanfei Nesharim Street in Jerusalem, suffering a penetrating injury.

Magen David Adom paramedics treated him at the scene and evacuated him to Shaare Zedek Medical Center.

flash_693059.description: An 84-year-old man was killed in Efrat after falling from his balcony while preparing to build a sukkah at his home.

flash_693057.description: A delegation of U.S. senators and representatives visited Samaria as lawmakers pledge new state legislation to recognize Judea and Samaria and drop the term West Bank.

flash_693052.description: On his final day, Moses does not look back - he prepares Israel for the future, passes the mantle to Joshua, and leaves behind a timeless lesson in leadership, humility and faith.

flash_693049.description: A Tel Aviv University study found that approximately 1,370 doctors left Israel for at least one year between 2023 and 2025, nearly twice the number a decade earlier.

flash_693047.description: Sportswear giant Adidas is facing boycott calls over a campaign in Israel featuring former IDF soldier Shalev Biton, who lost his left leg after being wounded while fighting near Gaza.

flash_693044.description: A serious indictment has been filed against a terrorist who disseminated inciting content on social media, praised terrorist attacks, and called for attacks against Jews.

flash_693042.description: The IDF struck terrorists and infrastructure belonging to the Hezbollah terrorist organization.

flash_693039.description: Mike Huckabee says bad behaviour should have consequences. But first you have to know what happened. Op-ed.

flash_693073.description: איחוד אפשרי בימין עשוי לשנות משמעותית את מפת המנדטים: לפי סקר כאן חדשות, רשימה משותפת של וינטר, סמוטריץ' ופייגלין זוכה ל-11 מנדטים. ללא וינטר, החיבור בין הציונות הדתית לזהות עומד על 6 מנדטים.

flash_693072.description: Lieberman’s party reveals its candidates for the 26th Knesset, while some prominent figures resign and others are left off the slate.

flash_693071.description: South African Queen, Princes and Princesses tour MDA’s advanced facilities in Israel, with one royal calling the experience ‘life-changing.’

flash_693070.description: Armed IDF soldier filmed at Tel Aviv train station wearing ‘Serial Killer’ and other unusual patches; IDF says he will face disciplinary proceedings.

flash_693069.description: A late-night call claiming three Israelis were being abducted sent police and IDF forces rushing to Hizma-only for investigators to allege the group had entered the village voluntarily and falsely reported an abduction.

flash_693068.description:
The Kiryat Shmona Municipality announced that IDF forces are expected to operate in Lebanon within the next hour, and that explosions may be heard in Kiryat Shmona and communities across the Galilee.

At this stage, normal routines remain in place and no special instructions have been issued to the public.

flash_693067.description: Knife-wielding suspect allegedly attacks civilian withdrawing cash at Jerusalem ATM; intended victim draws his pistol and shoots, severely wounding him.

flash_693066.description: Ayelet Shaked says she will not run in the upcoming elections

flash_693065.description: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir oversees surprise ‘Breaking Dawn 2.0’ exercise testing readiness for multi-front war and warns enemies of an immediate, heavy price.

flash_693062.description:
Following an initial investigation by officers from the Moriah Police Station, who arrived at the scene of the shooting incident in the Givat Shaul neighborhood in Jerusalem, police suspect that the incident was an attempted robbery during which the suspect was shot by one of those involved.

The suspect was evacuated to the hospital in serious condition, according to medical officials. Police said the incident was criminal in nature. Officers are operating at the scene, and the circumstances are under investigation.

flash_693060.description: The police are looking into a report of a suspected shooting incident in the Givat Shaul neighborhood in Jerusalem. Police forces are en route to the scene, and the incident is under review.

flash_693058.description: Netanyahu warns Iran against attacking Israel, says its regime is weak and faltering, and vows to complete a mission that will reshape the Middle East.

flash_693056.description:
Police officers from the Judea and Samaria District arrested a man in his 20s from Qibya on suspicion of involvement in a series of robberies and vehicle thefts on Route 446.

According to the suspicion, in one incident he stole a vehicle during a meeting arranged for the exchange of parts, and in another he staged a collision and rammed a vehicle in order to force it to stop and then rob it. The suspect was taken into custody at the conclusion of his interrogation.

flash_693079.description: How can the Democrat Party be so blatantly ant-Israel? Opinion.

flash_693078.description:
Five people were injured in a collision between two vehicles on Highway 99 near Snir. A 10-year-old girl sustained serious injuries, including abdominal trauma. A 19-year-old man was moderately injured, while three others sustained minor injuries.

Magen David Adom (MDA) teams evacuated the injured to Rambam and Ziv hospitals.

flash_693076.description: Lebanese media reported that Ali Shabib, a correspondent for the Hezbollah-affiliated Al-Manar network, was wounded in an IDF strike in Nabatieh, southern Lebanon.

flash_693074.description: Amazon Prime Air Boeing 767 overruns runway at Miami International Airport, with flames and thick smoke visible as authorities shut all runways.

flash_693085.description:
Palestinian Arabs reported clashes with Israelis in the village of Hajjah, east of Qalqilya. According to their claims, a drone operating over the village was brought down after Palestinian Arabs threw rocks at it. The Israelis then arrived in the village to retrieve the drone, leading to clashes at the scene.

According to the reports, an Israeli military force that arrived at the scene opened fire at Palestinian Arabs who were throwing stones at the soldiers. The Palestinian Arabs reported that one person was killed in the incident.

flash_693084.description: Iran says it will establish a “prohibited zone" near the Strait of Hormuz as petrol prices rise and US economic and military pressure intensifies.

flash_693083.description:
A man in his 40s was moderately injured after being hit by a car while riding an electric scooter in Ashdod.

Magen David Adom (MDA) teams provided him with medical treatment and evacuated him to Sheba Hospital at Tel Hashomer.

flash_693081.description: Arab media outlets reported that several people were injured in IDF strikes in central and northern Gaza.

flash_693077.description: The Health Ministry has issued new Kinneret bathing recommendations after a 9-year-old was hospitalized in severe condition with a rare amoeba infection.

flash_693075.description: Former minister Ayelet Shaked says she will not run in the upcoming elections, but is expected to join Likud.

flash_693092.description: 33-year-old woman arrested after police link her to burglaries at two synagogues in Monticello just days apart.

flash_693091.description: "Israel First" chairwoman Sharren Haskel tells Arutz Sheva-Israel National News she will not drop out of the race: "We will cross the electoral threshold."

flash_693090.description: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright says in TV interviews that Washington may prevent Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons by destroying its capabilities rather than reaching a deal.

flash_693088.description: The Religious Zionist Party’s central committee approves the technical bloc with Zehut and authorizes Smotrich to pursue additional alliances. The minister directly appeals to Ofer Winter.

flash_693086.description:
Lebanese media outlets reported that the IDF struck a vehicle in the Nabatieh area of southern Lebanon.

According to the reports, one person was killed and two others were injured in the strike.

flash_693082.description: At least five people were killed Sunday afternoon when an Amazon cargo aircraft overran the runway while landing at Miami International Airport and struck multiple vehicles on a road surrounding the airport, officials said.

flash_693080.description: Order signed by Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich to reduce the fuel excise tax takes effect at midnight. As a result, the price of a liter of gasoline falls from 8.25 shekels to 7.75 shekels.

flash_693112.description: Ahead of Rosh Hashanah, thousands of prayer notes removed from Western Wall for burial - including striking messages of peace sent from countries hostile to Israel.

flash_693111.description: Video shared on social media shows an ATV driver rampaging through Haifa. Police launched a manhunt and arrested him.

flash_693109.description:
A terrorist arrived by vehicle at the Maoz Yehuda farm and spoke with a resident who approached him. During the encounter, the terrorist stabbed the resident in the hand and fled the scene.

Read more

flash_693107.description: IDF hits Hezbollah weapons depots in southern Lebanon after another explosive drone is launched at Israeli troops.

flash_693105.description: Rebbetzin Sarah Toledano publicly challenged remarks made by her sisters in a Channel 12 News interview, declaring that Shas remains faithful to the legacy of her father, Maran Rabbi Ovadia Yosef.

flash_693103.description: Francesca Albanese supports a decision by the UK to ban trade with Judea and Samaria and also calls for expanding the boycott.

flash_693101.description: Hamas blatantly violates ceasefire, IDF engineering vehicle drives over explosive device.

flash_693099.description: Once again, Britain’s political leaders have completely lost their moral compass when it comes to Jews and Israel.

flash_693097.description: What is the history behind this magnetic Ukrainian city that draws tens of thousands of Jews every year?

flash_693095.description: The Torah’s guidance for the Jewish people as a whole is to work most of the day during the six weekdays, and establish regular times for Torah study in the morning and evening. A guide.

flash_693093.description: Susan Sarandon says Hollywood agencies still discourage casting her over her criticism of Israel's Gaza war, despite what she calls a shift in public opinion.

flash_693089.description: Germany's far-right AfD wins 44% in Saxony-Anhalt, more than doubling its support and dealing a major blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz.

flash_693087.description: Nova massacre survivors and hostages who returned from Gaza travel to Poland as part of a Selichot journey. At Auschwitz, they dance together.

flash_693133.description: After Winter submitted an independent slate, Smotrich attacked his decision; Amcha Yisrael chairman responds: “The public is asking for new people."

flash_693132.description: Ofer Winter files Amcha Yisrael slate and rules out a merger with Smotrich, who warns the independent run risks right-wing rule; Winter rejects ‘fearmongering.’

flash_693131.description:
Yesterday (Sunday), the IDF struck in the Gaza City area and eliminated the terrorist Yusuf Aqila, a Nukhba company commander in Hamas’ military wing.

In recent weeks, the terrorist advanced attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians and worked to restore the terrorist organization's capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorist was eliminated to remove the threat he posed.

flash_693130.description:
Hatzibur HaCharedi announced today that it has informed the chairman of the Amcha Yisrael party that it will not accept the merger proposal presented to it. Party officials said the decision was based on current polling, which, in their assessment, does not provide sufficient confidence that the proposed arrangement would cross the electoral threshold, nor would it secure adequate representation for the haredi public and answer the needs of its voters.

“Hatzibur HaCharedi will not enter into an arrangement that fails to provide our voters with a credible path to parliamentary representation," party officials said.

The party added that it remains committed to securing representation in the next Knesset for the Charedi public who are not represented, and the party leadership will continue to evaluate all available political options to secure that representation.

flash_693129.description: Netanel Jacobs recounts from his hospital bed at Beilinson the struggle with the terrorist who stabbed him.

flash_693128.description: Finance Ministry data released ahead of Rosh Hashanah 5787 show growth in Israel’s economy despite years of war and uncertainty, with foreign investment surging 78%, inflation falling and the shekel strengthening.

flash_693127.description:
Earlier today (Monday), during IDF patrols in the Beaufort area in southern Lebanon, a Hezbollah terrorist inside a building opened fire at the soldiers.

The soldiers returned fire and eliminated the terrorist.

During the close-quarters encounter, two IDF soldiers were lightly injured and were evacuated to receive medical treatment. Their families have been notified.

Additionally, the IDF struck weapons storage facilities, command centers, and additional terrorist infrastructure belonging to the Hezbollah terrorist organization in the area.

flash_693126.description: Thai authorities have ordered the deportation of Kevin Dimino, director of a wildlife park on Koh Samui, after he placed a Palestinian flag and signs prohibiting the entry of Israelis.

flash_693125.description: Ali Shabib, a reporter for the Hezbollah-affiliated Al-Manar network, was injured in an IDF strike in Nabatieh. Footage shows the moment he was hit during the live broadcast.

flash_693124.description: Kosovo joins international force to be stationed in Gaza under Trump plan

flash_693123.description: Ben-Gvir places pro-Israel advocate and Hebron spokesman Yishai Fleisher at No. 12 on Otzma Yehudit’s Knesset slate ahead of the upcoming elections.

flash_693122.description: Religious Zionist Party leader Bezalel Smotrich says he is seeking women, Sephardim, candidates from the periphery and reservists to join slate - but won’t sideline MKs without electoral gain.

flash_693121.description: After more than two decades as Belz’s Knesset representative, MK Yisrael Eichler is expected to make way for Elikim Stark at the Rebbe’s instruction.

flash_693120.description: Israel’s elite counterterrorism unit practices hostage rescues and neutralizing terrorists in an extreme multi-front attack scenario.

flash_693119.description: Rabbinical Alliance of America honors community leaders, warns of rising antisemitism and adopts resolutions backing Israel and opposing a Palestinian state.

flash_693118.description: Rosh Ha'ayin parents refuse to send children back to preschool until security is improved following consecutive intrusions into the compound.

flash_693117.description: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee condemns Samaria terror attack, says Israelis face daily attacks that receive less international attention.

flash_693116.description: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee responded: "This won’t get the international attention that attacks on Palestinians receive but it’s a daily occurrence that Israelis have to live with. for the 'Peace of Jerusalem.'"

flash_693115.description: A terrorist who stabbed a Jew at the Maoz Yehuda farm in Samaria and fled the scene has been eliminated.

flash_693114.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz warns Israel to launch an all-out campaign against Palestinian Authority terror infrastructure if 'intifada' returns to Judea and Samaria.

flash_693110.description: Warning signs? Suspected poisoning of livestock and water sources, 'If we remain silent while goats are poisoned, we will mourn when Israelis are poisoned.'

flash_693108.description:
IDF: Initial report - A report was received regarding an attempted stabbing attack near the area of Usarin. IDF soldiers have been dispatched to the area.

Read more

flash_693106.description: Rav Hutner would say that there is no such thing as "Minhag HaMakom" (local custom) in America, unlike in Europe where each community had Minhagim (customs) that went back hundreds of years. So that in America one may take on new Minhagim (customs).

flash_693104.description: Indictment filed against Arab Israeli after Shin Bet investigation reveals he pledged allegiance to ISIS, consumed terrorist organization’s propaganda.

flash_693144.description: Miami-Dade raises its Israel Bonds investment cap from 3% to 5%, potentially allowing up to $450 million, as opponents protest and tempers flare.

flash_693143.description: Red Cross visits to Israeli prisons are expected to resume for the first time since October 7. National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir criticized the High Court directive.

flash_693142.description: National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir attacked the High Court's directive to allow visits to security prisoners for the first time since October 7. He said the decision "constitutes a direct attack on the security deterrence of the State of Israel."

flash_693141.description: President Trump is intensifying his tone against Canada, as part of the trade war: The president has threatened to ban Canadian aircraft manufacturer Bombardier from selling its planes in the US - unless it transfers some of the production to his country.

flash_693140.description: For the first time since October 7, the defense establishment is preparing to resume Red Cross visits to security prisoners in Israeli prisons. According to Channel 12 News, the visits are expected to resume as early as this Wednesday.

flash_693139.description: Dr. Nechumi Yaffe joins HaTzibur HaCharedi, becoming the first woman included on the Knesset slate of a haredi party running in Israeli elections.

flash_693138.description: Rabbi Tzvi Tau instructs Avi Maoz and Noam activists to press ahead with their independent Knesset run, declaring the party will remain in the race through election day.

flash_693137.description:
Winter and Haddad celebrate filing of Amcha Yisrael party list with baklava

Amcha Yisrael Party chairman Ofer Winter and the slate’s number two candidate, Yoseph Haddad, were filmed celebrating with baklava after submitting their Knesset slate.

flash_693136.description: Police seize over half a ton of gas cylinders allegedly brought illegally from Judea and Samaria and dangerously stored and sold without required safety checks.

flash_693135.description:
0:00 /
1x
IDF redirects strike to avoid harming civiliansIDF Spokesperson

Yesterday (Sunday), the IDF intended to carry out a strike targeting a Hamas military wing terrorist in the Gaza Strip.

During the strike, a gathering of civilians was identified near the terrorist. Since the munition could not be canceled after it had been released, it was redirected in real time to prevent harm to civilians.

Read more

flash_693134.description: A delegation of 20 American lawmakers toured Samaria and announced that they would work to advance countermeasures against entities that boycott residents because of where they live.

flash_693152.description: Oren Dobronsky, whom Netanyahu had designated for the 11th spot, to be left off the Likud slate because he would have to give up his US citizenship.

flash_693151.description:
Seven soccer fans were detained for questioning on Monday evening following a soccer match at Turner Stadium in Be'er Sheva between local side Hapoel Be'er Sheva and Maccabi Tel Aviv.

They were also banned from attending soccer matches for 60 days.

flash_693150.description:
National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir responded to Britain's expected decision to impose sanctions on Judea and Samaria.

"The time has come for the State of Israel to publicly recognize the Falkland Islands as occupied Argentine territory, which the British are violently stealing from the Argentine people. The British are not only occupying the territory, but are also conducting oil drilling there and stealing money from the Argentine people," he said.

"I call on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to recognize Argentina's sovereignty over the Falkland Islands and impose sanctions on Great Britain for as long as the occupation continues," added Ben Gvir.

flash_693149.description: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich calls for the British ambassador to be expelled ahead of expected sanctions on Judea and Samaria: The British Mandate is over.

flash_693148.description:
Three suspects were arrested in Lod on suspicion of involvement in the shooting of two people in the city this evening.

According to the police, the forces arrived at the scene shortly after receiving the report, began searching and located the three. They were taken in for questioning.

flash_693146.description: Netanyahu instructed the negotiating team with Lebanon to gather information on the 11 Jews who were executed in the 1980s. A former adviser to Rabin recounts their story.

flash_693158.description: Benny Gantz announces that Dr. Aliza Bloch has joined the Blue and White party’s slate, praising her ability to "bridge different parts of society."

flash_693157.description: CENTCOM says US forces redirected 94 commercial vessels and boarded two as Washington enforces its maritime blockade against Iran. Trump: Oil prices will drop when we win the war.

flash_693156.description:
Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani said at a meeting of Arab League foreign ministers that weapons must be under the sole control of the state, adding that armed factions have been integrated into the Syrian army.

Al-Shaibani also said that Damascus opposes Iranian attacks against the Gulf states and Jordan and supports a diplomatic solution with Israel.

flash_693154.description: Argentine President Javier Milei shares Ben Gvir's social post calling on Israel to recognize Argentina's sovereignty over the Falkland Islands and impose sanctions on Britain.

flash_693147.description:
Britain intends to impose a trade ban on products manufactured in Judea and Samaria tomorrow (Tuesday), the New York Times reported.

According to the report, these are "extensive economic restrictions targeting Israeli settlements."

Read more.

flash_693145.description: Channel 12 poll has Netanyahu and his rivals tied at 52 seats each, while Channel 14 gives the Prime Minister’s bloc a commanding 63 seats to 44.

flash_693172.description: Haaretz claims UAE President warned Netanyahu of planned large-scale military action by Hamas days before October 7th.

flash_693171.description:
Lebanese Foreign Minister Youssef Raggi accused the Hezbollah terrorist organization of dragging the country into two consecutive wars over the past two years, despite repeated warnings about the dangers involved and the expected harm to Lebanon’s security.

In an address to a meeting of Arab foreign ministers in Cairo, Raggi strongly condemned Israeli strikes and violations of Lebanese sovereignty, as well as Israel’s seizure of extensive areas in the country.

flash_693169.description: Tehran threatens a new Persian Gulf exclusion zone and missile attacks on US forces as Washington’s blockade chokes Iranian oil exports.

flash_693167.description: Houthi missiles and drones strike four southern Saudi cities, wounding 73 civilians, as Yemeni government forces report advances on several fronts.

flash_693165.description:
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham spoke with the Emir of Qatar about the situation in the Middle East, particularly in Gaza and Judea and Samaria.

Burnham’s office said he told the Emir that he was focused on securing calm and supporting regional partners in an effort to restore stability and security.

flash_693163.description: The Democrats party is focusing efforts on increasing voter turnout among Israel's Arab citizens. In a video, Golan says going to the polls will prevent Netanyahu from remaining prime minister.

flash_693161.description: Adidas apologizes after its campaign featuring former IDF soldier Shalev Biton draws backlash and boycott calls from pro-Palestinian Arab activists.

flash_693159.description: Wizz Air is adding dozens of weekly Tel Aviv flights, expanding service to Europe as SAS, Delta and United also resume Israel routes.

flash_693155.description: Florida Congressman Randy Fine warns Britain that companies complying with Israel sanctions could be barred from doing business with Florida governments.

flash_693153.description:
MK Moshe Gafni has agreed to be appointed chairman of the national movement of Degel HaTorah.

MK Uri Maklev will continue to serve as a member of the party's senior leadership.

flash_693192.description: Arab reports of Israeli strike in Sheikh Radwan in Gaza

flash_693191.description: IDF investigates how a Syrian citizen reached a military installation in the southern Golan Heights undetected; initial inquiry finds no attempted attack.

flash_693190.description: A surprising new survey reveals who is making the pilgrimage to Uman, and the striking gaps by religion, age, gender, income and ethnic background.

flash_693188.description: Police arrested three Hebron residents allegedly staying illegally at a Golan Heights guesthouse. One was found hiding injured inside a sewage channel.

flash_693186.description: Kiryat Malachi’s flag is raised at a new twin cities square near Paris, with an Israeli diplomat hailing the gesture as one of ‘friendship and solidarity.’

flash_693184.description: IDF and Border Police forces eliminate an armed terrorist and arrest four wanted suspects in Samaria, including a terrorist allegedly planning an imminent attack.

flash_693182.description: The 71-year-old New Yorker walked out of Tehran’s notorious Evin Prison after years behind bars.

flash_693168.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s associates are making a last-minute effort to bring about a merger between Avi Maoz’s Noam L'Yisrael party and Bezalel Smotrich’s Religious Zionist Party, Kan Reshet Bet reported on Tuesday morning.

No substantive talks are currently taking place between Maoz and Smotrich, but Netanyahu’s associates are trying to persuade both sides that a merger would serve their interests. They have warned that running independently could prompt Maoz to withdraw shortly before the elections and that Likud’s campaign would prevent his party from gaining support.

flash_693187.description:
President Isaac Herzog addressed discussions in Britain and other countries about imposing sanctions, saying that if they are enacted, “it would constitute a grave error in judgment and a choice to stand on the wrong side of history."

Herzog added that such measures would amount to “blatant interference in democratic elections" and urged foreign governments: “Stop! Step back from the dead end of sanctions and boycotts."
